start_here: Say to your AI: "Start the workflow that makes short vertical videos from my footage." It asks tool:workflow-run-start for that recipe and keeps the event_id it answers, which is how the run is found afterwards.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: the run's rows are the engine's, and the recipe is read from the person's workflow recipes.
instructions: 1. Name the recipe id (workflow), your AI's record id (caller: the starter, such as ai:claude-code-...), the database the recipe is in (database) and the input the run takes (input, optional). If you do not know the id, find it first with tool:workflow-run-find.

2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:workflow-run-start and input {workflow, caller, database, input?}. The program runs on the person's own computer through the run's door.
3. Keep result.event_id. Start refuses, and sends nothing, when the recipe is not in that database, the engine will not list its wakes, or no waiter is alive.

worked_examples.title: A start of the short-video workflow answers its event id
worked_examples.ask: Start the workflow that makes short vertical videos from my footage.

input.request: make short vertical videos from my footage

worked_examples.step: none (the start only sends the fact)
